newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Abidjan bourse rises after five weeks of declines.
newsitem.headline: Abidjan bourse rises after five weeks of declines.

text.p: The Abidjan Stock Exchange (BVA) moved into positive territory after five straight weeks of declines, the bourse report showed on Friday.

The BVA All-Share Index ended the week to Friday up 0.93 percent to 360.26 from 356.95 the previous week. The 12 VB blue chips index however remained depressed, down 0.06 percent to 241.10 points from 241.25 points.
Turnover more than doubled to 110 billion CFA francs from 58 billion CFA.
Tobacco group SITAB fell in heavy volume as the most active stock, accounting for 26.83 percent of total bourse transanctions for the week. It ended the week 2050 CFA lower at 41,450 CFA.
